comment: Hand-maintained. Every network entry is pinned to a DATED upstream release
URL (never /releases/latest/) plus a byte size and SHA-256, so an import can
be integrity-checked before a single row reaches the database.
kind=yomitanZip downloads `url`; kind=bundledAsset imports `asset` from the
APK and needs no network. `title` is the dictionary's stable title family
the installed DictionaryMeta.name is matched against (the upstream zip may
append a revision in brackets, e.g. "JMdict [2026-09-15]").
Two entries may share a title family when they are mutually exclusive
variants (the two JMdict builds): the importer replaces by title, and the
installed DictionaryMeta.catalogId records which one is installed, so only
one row lights up. The first entry of a family is the title-only default.

entries.name: JMdict (English)
entries.description: The standard Japanese-to-English dictionary: words, readings, parts of speech and glosses, without example sentences. The one to install first.
entries.title: JMdict

entries.name: JMdict (English, with examples)
entries.description: The same JMdict entry set, with example sentences from the Tatoeba Project on each sense. A larger download; install it instead of the plain JMdict, not alongside it.
entries.title: JMdict

entries.name: KANJIDIC (English)
entries.description: Per-kanji readings, meanings, grade, stroke count and frequency. Fills in the kanji half of a lookup.
entries.title: KANJIDIC

entries.name: Kanjium Pitch Accents
entries.description: Tokyo pitch accents (downstep positions) from the Kanjium dataset. Bundled in the app and installed at first launch; no download.
entries.title: Kanjium Pitch Accents
